messages.subject: sleep onset shift for the first night
parts:
Dear all,
as previously described in another post, we are currently analysing 7-days Actigraph data, with half a day at the beginning and at the end of the measurement period. 
We found out that for those datasets, that started after 12h00, the sleep onset (part 4) of the first night is shifted to the left (please see example below). The HDCZA algorithm was used for the analysis (no sleeplog).



Does somebody know why this happens? Changing e.g. includenightcrit didn't change anything and we wanted to keep the first and last night.
Thanks in advance!
Best,
Anne
